answer.reason: Beyond the rape and his death, already in the summary, the verses give his request for Dinah as wife and his offer of any dowry.

clauses.english: asked his father Hamor to get Dinah for him as wife
clauses.quote: Get me this damsel to wife.

clauses.english: offered Jacob's sons any dowry they asked for Dinah
clauses.quote: Ask me never so much dowry and gift

doubts: GEN 34:24 does not say outright that Shechem himself was circumcised, so it is not used.
JOS 24:32, JDG 9:28 and ACT 7:16 mention Shechem only as Hamor's son or as the name of a place, and are left out.
GEN 33:19 names him only as Hamor's son.
